contrast: Four-level published diagnosis: Bacterial infection n=114; Fungal infection n=78; Lung cancer n=122; Pulmonary tuberculosis n=86
endpoint: Aitchison community composition; omnibus PERMANOVA R2 with paired PERMDISP
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique patient
covariates_or_strata: Primary diagnosis-only model; restrict permutations within published Training/Test cohort; sensitivity for collection year
justification: All four groups are adequately represented in both published splits; the estimand is a bounded association across 400 available runs
main_limitations: Observational association; no healthy group; age, sex, antibiotics, treatment, severity and comorbidities unavailable; diagnosis ascertainment details are not encoded in the frozen mapping

analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique patient
justification: Measures complementary ecological organization without selecting pairwise results first
main_limitations: Depth and classifier yield dependent; direct-species subcomposition is not absolute burden; multiplicity across endpoints

contrast: Lung cancer versus each infectious diagnosis separately (three prespecified contrasts), only after omnibus A1
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique patient
covariates_or_strata: Same restrictions as A1; familywise multiplicity correction across three contrasts
justification: Avoids combining bacterial, fungal and TB infections while addressing clinically interpretable contrasts
main_limitations: Not independent replication; post-omnibus interpretation only; residual clinical confounding

analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per unique patient
covariates_or_strata: Same restrictions as A1; multiplicity correction across the full contrast family
justification: May identify which groups drive an omnibus result
main_limitations: Large contrast family and no independently replicated target; should not drive the manuscript title or primary claim

analysis_unit: One valid native report per patient
covariates_or_strata: Report by diagnosis; Training/Test and collection-year sensitivity
justification: Tests whether technical classifier yield differs by clinical grouping
main_limitations: Classified fraction is not bacterial burden and is sensitive to host content, database coverage and read properties

analysis_unit: One valid native report per patient
covariates_or_strata: At least 10% within-anchor prevalence; 5% and 20% sensitivity; multiplicity control
justification: Uses detection rather than relative magnitude and supports bounded common-taxon follow-up
main_limitations: Detection depends on depth and classification; many taxa; no external identical contrast

covariates_or_strata: Cohort-specific ANCOM-BC2; ALDEx2 sensitivity; global test before post hoc contrasts
justification: Can localize an omnibus community association if effect sizes and uncertainty are reported
main_limitations: Compositionality, sparse features, contamination and multiple testing; no disease-specific replication

contrast: Lung cancer versus a single pooled infection group
analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per patient
justification: The three infection diagnoses are biologically heterogeneous and already support a four-level design
main_limitations: Pooling would create a broad contrast whose meaning is not shared by PRJCA046985

analysis_unit: One unique BALF DNA run per patient
justification: The available data support association, not intervention or exchangeability
main_limitations: Unmeasured clinical confounding and observational ascertainment
